returns_stage_requested_description: Customers asked to return these items. Approve or decline each request in your store.
returns_stage_awaiting_items_description: Approved returns whose items haven’t all arrived back yet.
returns_stage_awaiting_refund_descriptio: Items are back, or weren’t expected back, and haven’t been refunded.
returns_stage_refund_pending_description: A refund payment is processing. The customer hasn’t received the money yet.
returns_stage_refund_failed_description: Every payment attempt for the refund failed. Retry the refund in your store.
returns_stage_ready_to_close_description: Returns that are received and refunded but still open.
returns_stage_refunded_description: Refunds without a return whose payment succeeded.
returns_stage_refund_recorded_descriptio: Refunds recorded without a payment, such as a restock with no money back.
returns_stage_unknown_description: Returns with a status Luma doesn’t recognize.
returns_refund_payments_failed: {count, plural, one {{count, number} payment failed} other {{count, number} payments failed}}
returns_next_requested: Review the request, then approve or decline it in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_next_awaiting_items_unreported: Waiting for the customer to send the items back.
returns_next_awaiting_items: Waiting for {remaining, plural, one {{remaining, number} unit} other {{remaining, number} units}} to arrive back. {received, number} of {quantity, number} received.
returns_next_refund_remaining: Refund the remaining {remaining, plural, one {{remaining, number} unit} other {{remaining, number} units}} in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_next_issue_refund: The items are back. Issue the refund in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_next_refund_pending_amount: {amount} is processing with the payment provider. The customer hasn’t received it yet.
returns_next_refund_pending: A refund is processing with the payment provider. The customer hasn’t received it yet.
returns_next_refund_failed: The refund payment failed. Retry the refund in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_next_ready_to_close: The items are back and refunded. Close the return in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_next_closed: The return is closed. Nothing is pending.
returns_next_declined: The return was declined. No items or money are expected.
returns_next_cancelled: The return was canceled. Nothing is pending.
returns_next_refund_recorded: {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {The connected system}} recorded this refund without a payment, so no money was returned.
returns_next_unknown: Luma doesn’t recognize this return’s status. Check the return in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}}.
returns_access_not_granted: {connection} hasn’t granted access to returns. Reconnect it so Luma can read returns and refunds.
returns_access_reconnect_shopify: {connection} was connected before Luma could read returns. Reconnect it to share returns and refunds with Luma.
returns_access_not_shared: {connection} doesn’t share returns with Luma. Returns handled in {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {this system}} aren’t shown here.
returns_step_units_to_return: {count, plural, one {{count, number} unit to return} other {{count, number} units to return}}
returns_step_declined_return_period_ende: Declined because the return period ended
returns_step_declined_final_sale: Declined because the item was a final sale
returns_step_received_unreported: The source doesn’t report returned items
returns_step_received_detail: {received, number} of {quantity, plural, one {{quantity, number} unit} other {{quantity, number} units}} received
returns_row_failed_payments: {count, plural, one {{count, number} failed payment} other {{count, number} failed payments}}
returns_list_search_placeholder: Return, order number, reason, or source ID…
returns_list_note: Store observations and Luma return cases stay separate. Open a case to receive, inspect and request governed actions. Only independently observed successful payments count as money returned.
returns_empty_filtered_body: Try another return name, order number, reason, or source.
returns_empty_importing_body: Luma is reading return history from your store. Returns appear here as they’re imported.
returns_empty_none_body: No connected store has reported a return or refund yet. New returns appear here after the next sync.
returns_empty_not_shared_body: Returns appear here once a connected store shares returns and refunds with Luma.
returns_empty_view_action_body: Every return is waiting on the customer or payment provider, or is done.
returns_empty_view_action_body_waiting: Every return is waiting on the customer or payment provider, or is done. {count, number} waiting.
returns_detail_description_refund: Refund without a return for order {order} · {source}
returns_detail_offline: You’re offline. The return below may be out of date.
returns_detail_missing_body: This return isn’t in this workspace, or no connected system reports it anymore.
returns_detail_no_access: You no longer have access to returns in this workspace.
returns_detail_refresh_failed: This return couldn’t be refreshed. The details below may be out of date.
returns_detail_load_failed: This return couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
returns_detail_luma_note: Use a Luma return case to record receipt and inspection and request governed actions. Luma also reads {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}} independently.
returns_order_details_title: Order details from {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the source}}
returns_order_details_description: Customer, payments, and events for this order, read live from {system, select, shopify {Shopify} jtl {JTL-Wawi} cin7 {Cin7 Core} other {the connected system}} with the connection’s permissions.
returns_history_description: Each entry is what Luma read from the source, newest first. It shows the state at that moment, not every change in between.
returns_money_description: Only successful refund payments count as money returned.
returns_money_not_received: The customer hasn’t received it yet
returns_money_item_value_hint: After discounts. This isn’t an amount refunded.
returns_money_several_currencies: Refund payments use several currencies, so Luma doesn’t add them up. Each payment is listed under Refunds.
returns_refunds_description: Each refund with every payment attempt, as the source reports them.
returns_refunds_no_payment: No payment is attached to this refund, so no money was returned through it.
returns_refunds_none_expected: No refund is expected for this return.
returns_refunds_none_yet: No refund has been issued for this return yet.
returns_items_description: Requested units with the reason given, and what the source reports as received and refunded.
returns_items_unmatched: Not matched to an order line
returns_order_missing: This source no longer reports the order.
returns_order_section_units: {source} · {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}} · {refund}
returns_order_section_empty: No return or refund is imported for this order.
returns_case_description: {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}} from order {order} · {source}
returns_case_load_failed: The return case couldn’t be loaded.
returns_case_refresh_failed: The return case couldn’t be refreshed. You’re seeing the last loaded version.
returns_case_missing_body: It may belong to another workspace, or the link is incomplete.
returns_case_no_access: You don’t have permission to view returns in this workspace.
returns_case_stage_awaiting_receipt_desc: Record what arrives back. Units that don’t arrive count as missing.
returns_case_stage_awaiting_inspection_d: Judge every received unit as resellable or damaged.
returns_case_stage_awaiting_proposal_des: Propose a refund, exchange, store credit or rejection, and which resellable units go back to stock.
returns_case_stage_proposed_description: The proposal is recorded. Refunds, restocking and exchanges happen separately and nothing has changed in the store yet.
returns_case_stage_cancelled_description: This case no longer counts. Its units can be returned again.
returns_case_creation_failure_withheld: Policy or the approval no longer allows this. Nothing was sent.
returns_case_creation_failure_not_accept: The system refused the request before creating anything. Check the warehouse, reason and order, then request again.
returns_case_creation_failure_mismatch: The system holds a return for this case that doesn’t match the approved lines. Review it there before anything else is sent.
returns_case_creation_failure_changed: The case, its lines or the approval changed. Nothing was sent. Request again.
returns_case_creation_failure_not_sent: The request couldn’t be sent. Nothing was dispatched. Request again.
returns_case_blocker_execution_disabled: Creating returns from Luma isn’t enabled on this server.
returns_case_blocker_unsupported: The order’s system can’t create returns from Luma.
returns_case_blocker_reconnect: {system} isn’t allowed to create returns yet. Reconnect it in Apps with return access.
returns_case_blocker_connection_inactive: The {system} connection isn’t active. Check it in Apps.
returns_case_blocker_unmapped: Some lines aren’t linked to {system} yet. Sync the order, then try again.
returns_case_blocker_in_progress: A request to create this return is in progress.
returns_case_history_description: Who decided what, when and on which evidence. Earlier decisions stay here after a correction.
returns_case_history_opened: Opened for {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}}
returns_case_history_receipt: Receipt recorded: {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}} received
returns_case_history_inspection: Inspection recorded: {resellable, number} resellable, {damaged, number} damaged
returns_case_history_creation_requested: Approval requested to create the return in {system}
returns_case_lines_description: Requested units, what arrived and how it was judged. Missing units were requested but didn’t arrive.
returns_case_lines_caption: Units requested, received, judged and to restock, per item
returns_case_decisions_description: The current receipt, inspection and proposal, with who recorded them.
returns_case_line_requested: {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}} requested
returns_case_line_judged: {resellable, number} resellable · {damaged, number} damaged · {missing, number} missing
returns_case_receipt_description: Enter the units that physically arrived back for each line. Units that didn’t arrive count as missing.
returns_case_receipt_description_replace: This replaces the current receipt and clears the inspection and proposal that relied on it. The history keeps them.
returns_case_inspection_description: Judge every received unit as resellable or damaged. Only resellable units can go back to stock.
returns_case_inspection_unbalanced: Resellable and damaged units must add up to the received units of each line.
returns_case_proposal_description: Choose how to settle the return and how many resellable units of each line go back to stock.
returns_case_proposal_rejection: A rejected return goes back to the customer, so nothing is restocked.
returns_case_proposal_only: This proposal sends nothing. Request stock and refund actions separately, then obtain approval.
returns_case_cancel_description: The case stays in the history, and its units can be returned again.
returns_case_creation_description: Create this case’s return in {system} so the warehouse can receive it there. Another person approves the request first.
returns_case_creation_dialog_description: Choose the warehouse that receives the items and the return reason {system} records. Someone else who can approve changes approves it; Luma then creates it once and checks it in {system}.
returns_case_creation_loading: Reading warehouses and return reasons from {system}…
returns_case_creation_no_credit: Luma creates the return without a credit. Refunds stay a separate decision in {system}.
returns_case_creation_review: Check the lines, warehouse and reason. Luma creates the return in {system} right after approval.
returns_case_creation_waiting_approval: Waiting for someone else who can approve changes.
returns_case_creation_uncertain: {system} didn’t confirm the request. Luma checks whether the return exists and won’t send it again.
returns_case_creation_created: An independent read found exactly this return in {system}.
returns_case_creation_observe_only: Observe-only. Would run when writes are enabled. Nothing was sent.
returns_case_error_unavailable: Return cases are unavailable. Try again later.
returns_case_error_access: You don’t have permission to change returns in this workspace.
returns_case_error_unconfirmed: Luma couldn’t confirm whether this was saved. Retry to send the same request again safely.
returns_case_order_item: Return case · {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}}
returns_case_order_nothing_left: Every unit of this order is already in a return.
returns_case_open_description: Choose the lines and units the customer sends back. Units already in another return can’t be added again.
returns_case_open_description_store: The case works this store return. Its lines are prefilled; the store’s record stays as it is.
returns_case_open_returnable: {returnable, number} of {ordered, number} can be returned
returns_case_open_nothing: Nothing on this order can be returned anymore.
returns_case_store_section_description: Luma’s own record of receipt, inspection and resolution for this return.
returns_case_store_worked: A return case works this return.
returns_case_store_description: Open a case to record receipt and inspection and to propose a resolution.
returns_case_store_closed: This return is declined or cancelled in the store.
returns_case_store_action: Work this return in a case
returns_case_approval_description: Approve the existing customer return request. Luma checks the exact return and quantities before sending and verifies the result independently.
returns_service_no_cases: No return cases for this customer.
returns_service_customer_title: What you can tell the customer
returns_service_receipt_summary: The warehouse recorded receipt of {units} units.
returns_service_proposal_summary: A resolution is proposed. Execution and payment still need separate confirmation.
returns_service_source_unavailable: Source evidence is unavailable. Financial status cannot be confirmed.
returns_service_source_missing: The store has not reported financial progress for this case.
returns_service_source_stale: Source evidence is stale. Read fresh evidence before confirming payment to the customer.
returns_service_payment_unconfirmed: No successful payment has been confirmed. A refund request does not mean the customer has received money.
returns_service_waiting_check: An independent source check; outcome unconfirmed
returns_service_queue_approval: The return action needs an independent approval.
returns_service_queue_uncertain: The return action is unconfirmed. Check the source before taking another action.
returns_service_queue_manual: The return needs receipt, inspection or settlement by its owner.
returns_service_queue_consequence: Review source evidence and continue the case. A proposal changes nothing in the connected systems.
returns_service_payment_scope: Payment amounts cover the linked store return. They do not establish that this case is settled.
returns_service_blocker_inspection: Received items have not been inspected.
returns_service_blocker_proposal: A resolution has not been proposed.
returns_service_blocker_settlement: Settlement has not been independently verified.
returns_service_cancelled_wait: No further work on this cancelled case.
returns_service_completed_wait: This exchange was completed after independent checks in both systems.
returns_settlement_description: Request approval for each step separately. Only a fresh, independent source check confirms resale stock or money returned.
returns_settlement_unavailable: Settlement is unavailable. The outcome is unconfirmed.
returns_settlement_unsupported: Settlement actions are unavailable for these connections. Assign an owner to complete and verify them in the connected systems.
returns_settlement_observe_only: Observe only; no write is sent
returns_settlement_empty: No stock or refund action has been requested.
returns_settlement_no_warehouse: No authorized Wawi warehouse is mapped to these resale items. Review the mapping before restocking.
returns_settlement_locked: Settlement has started. Receipt, inspection and proposal stay fixed so the approved actions cannot change.
returns_settlement_targets_unavailable: Warehouse choices are unavailable. Read the Wawi connection again before restocking.
returns_exchange_description: One tracked replacement, with separate fulfillment and payment evidence. Returned stock is settled separately.
returns_exchange_no_choices: No explicitly mapped Shopify and Wawi replacement is available. Ask a workspace administrator to check item mappings and access.
returns_exchange_availability: Stock shown is reported availability, not a reservation. Luma checks both systems before processing.
returns_exchange_waiting: This choice belongs to the case owner. Luma will not choose a substitute or refund automatically.
returns_exchange_wawi_handoff: Wawi allocation needs the case owner. Match the replacement request to the ERP order before shipping.
returns_exchange_stock_unavailable: Replacement stock is unavailable. Choose wait, a different item or a refund.
returns_exchange_stock_unknown: Replacement stock is not freshly verified. Check the source before processing.
returns_deadlines_description: Choose deadlines from recorded case events. Turn on Follow up on overdue return steps in Workflows to monitor automatically.
returns_deadlines_inspection: Inspection and proposal deadline (hours after the preceding step)
returns_deadlines_financial: Financial deadline (hours after proposal or action request)
returns_waiting_description: Recorded physical decisions and independent money evidence have separate deadlines. Earlier escalations stay in history.
returns_waiting_none: No waiting occurrence is recorded. Configure deadlines and check progress, or activate the follow-up workflow.
returns_waiting_not_requested: Financial action not sent to source
returns_waiting_superseded: Replaced by a later event or policy
returns_case_stage_completed_description: The last independent check verified stock, the replacement order and settled money in both systems.
returns_case_history_exchange_completed: Exchange completed after independent checks in both systems
returns_case_history_exchange_reopened: Exchange reopened because the systems no longer agree
returns_exchange_consistency_description: Record physical receipt in Shopify and create one paid Wawi replacement order with this external reference. Reserve its exact item and quantity. Luma independently checks every step before completing the case.
returns_exchange_complete_unresolved: Exchange unresolved · case owner must follow up
returns_exchange_check_stock: Returned units in correct physical stock
returns_exchange_check_payment: Replacement price and settled money match
returns_exchange_reason_source_unavailab: Fresh complete source evidence is unavailable. Check connection access and retry.
returns_exchange_reason_missing_receipt: Record every requested unit that actually arrived.
returns_exchange_reason_source_receipt_u: The source has not independently confirmed the exact receipt. Record warehouse receipt in Shopify.
returns_exchange_reason_stock_unverified: Verify the approved Wawi restock and matching Shopify stock disposition. Concurrent stock movements need review.
returns_exchange_reason_writeoff_unverif: Damaged stock needs independently verified disposal by the physical stock owner. This pair cannot prove disposal yet.
returns_exchange_reason_duplicate_replac: Multiple Wawi orders use this reference. Reconcile them before completing.
returns_exchange_reason_replacement_miss: Create one Wawi order for the exact mapped replacement item and quantity with this reference. Verify Shopify processing.
returns_exchange_reason_reservation_miss: Wawi has not reserved the exact replacement quantity for this order.
returns_exchange_reason_price_mismatch: The native replacement price and Wawi order total do not agree, or price evidence is missing.
returns_exchange_reason_money_unsettled: Wait for independently verified payment or refund and record the matching paid Wawi order.
returns_exchange_reason_fulfillment_not_: Verify replacement fulfillment and release any payment hold through its separate approval.
returns_field_stage_description: Where the return stands, worked out from what the store reports. The store owns it, so Luma never moves a return between stages.
returns_field_partially_received_descrip: Some but not all requested units arrived. Unknown when the store doesn’t report receipt.
returns_list_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} return} other {{count, number} returns}}
returns_preview_unavailable: The return’s details couldn’t be loaded.
